overview: The commission coordinated volunteer staffing for several upcoming autumn community events and discussed progress on the Wellington underpass and Blue Bike expansions. Key decisions included forming a subcommittee for a future speaker series and adopting an information-gathering approach for a potential 2024 Halloween bike parade.

items.title: Roll Call and Minutes
items.summary: Approved the minutes from the July 26, 2023 meeting.

items.title: Upcoming Community Events
items.summary: Members discussed logistics and volunteer coverage for the Youth Bike Safety Workshop, Tufts Community Day, Walk and Roll to School Day, and the Harvest Your Energy Festival.

items.title: Social Media and Wellington Underpass
items.summary: The commission discussed using social media algorithms to improve public awareness of infrastructure projects, including the design and funding status of the Wellington underpass.

items.title: Bike Rack Grant and Private Guidelines
items.summary: Announced a grant for 40 new public bike racks and discussed providing technical guidance to private businesses to encourage standardized rack installations on their properties.

items.title: Halloween Bike Parade
items.summary: Approved a motion to gather safety and venue data from neighboring towns to inform the planning of a potential parade for next year rather than holding an event in 2023.

items.title: Speaker Series Subcommittee
items.summary: Approved the creation of an ad hoc subcommittee to organize a recurring educational speaker series for the public at local venues.

items.title: Infrastructure and Boston Avenue Restoration
items.summary: Discussed new Blue Bike station locations for West Medford Square and Logan Park, as well as advocacy for protected bike lanes during the restoration of Boston Avenue following a Tufts University development project.
